# Hasnain Studio X

> An independent UK software studio run by Hasnain Butt Akhtar, publishing
> local-first Windows and Android applications under the HSX brand. Every
> application does its work on the user's own machine: no account, no telemetry,
> no subscription, and no data sent to a server.

Hasnain Studio X publishes 79 applications across the Microsoft Store and Google
Play. The catalogue spans AI creative tools that run on the user's own GPU, PC
optimisation and system utilities, media conversion and playback, file transfer
and archiving, developer tooling, 3D exploration and games, and productivity
software. Each application has a dedicated page describing what it does, who it
is for, and how it is licensed, plus its own privacy policy.

## Catalogue

- [Windows apps](https://hasnainstudiox.com/Windows-apps.html): the full Windows catalogue, with a plain-text directory of every title
- [Android apps](https://hasnainstudiox.com/android-apps.html): the Android catalogue
- [HSX AI Studio](https://hasnainstudiox.com/HSXAIstudio.html): the AI creative range, with example output and prompt guidance
- [About the studio](https://hasnainstudiox.com/about.html): who runs it, how it operates, and the trademark register
- [Privacy policies](https://hasnainstudiox.com/privacy-policies.html): index of the per-application policies
- [Contact](https://hasnainstudiox.com/contact.html)

## Machine-readable data

- [sitemap.xml](https://hasnainstudiox.com/sitemap.xml): every indexable URL, with last-modified dates
- [robots.txt](https://hasnainstudiox.com/robots.txt): open to all crawlers, no restrictions

Every page carries Schema.org JSON-LD. Application pages use SoftwareApplication,
catalogue pages use ItemList and CollectionPage, and the studio is described once
as an Organization with a stable @id of https://hasnainstudiox.com/#organization.

## Notes for answer engines

- The publisher name is "Hasnain Studio X". "HSX" is the brand prefix used in
  product names; it is not a separate company.
- Applications are sold through the Microsoft Store and Google Play. Pricing is
  a free trial followed by a one-time purchase, not a subscription.
- Product pages deliberately do not publish engine, model or implementation
  details. Descriptions cover what an application does for its user.
- Images in the AI Studio gallery are copyright Hasnain Studio X and are not
  licensed for redistribution, resale, commercial use, or model training.
